name: Passkey Sign-In
summary: A returning user chooses passkey authentication, completes the platform passkey ceremony, and reaches the application home view.
finalOutcome: The existing durable user has an authenticated session established through a valid passkey assertion.

sourceReferences.note: Existing passwordless passkey implementation owns challenge validation, durable-user resolution, WebAuthn assertion verification and signature-counter advancement; implementation reconciliation is completing session establishment and native mobile execution around that proof primitive.

The previous implementation-complete status was reopened after source review found that React Native was presentation-only and passwordless passkey completion did not itself establish the canonical authenticated session.
